_doc: callusguard guarding its own repository. Project-level, committed, so anyone who
opens this repo in Claude Code gets the same screening the tool ships to everyone
else — and so a change that breaks the hook fails here first.
The ruleset is deliberately NOT overridden: with no AGENT_GUARD_RULES set, the hook
falls through to callusguard/guard/rules/starter.rules.json, which is exactly what a
new adopter runs. Repo-specific rules belong here only once telemetry has earned
them; hand-writing a set would be the imagination this tool exists to replace.
Behaviour is fail-open by design (see docs/THREAT_MODEL.md): any error in the hook
exits 0 and the tool call proceeds. This cannot wedge a session.
The recorder is not wired here — it needs Postgres and a running server. See
docs/TELEMETRY.md, and examples/settings-hooks.json for the recorder's own block.
